purpose: Teach: 排斥/テロリズム/美化/道義/加担/横領/危害/儒教

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 本件、外国人排斥的な落書きを警察、捜査されてますね
lines.en: So the police are investigating that anti-foreigner graffiti case, then?
lines.style: Thoughtful, measured opening. Slight upward inflection on the question. Genuinely curious but respectful of the sensitivity. Pause before speaking, choosing words carefully.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 警察、テロリズム対策のため訓練を続けます
lines.en: We're continuing our training on counterterrorism operations.
lines.style: Steady, official register. Clear enunciation. No extra weight, just factual. Measured pace. The voice of institutional responsibility — present but not performed.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 本件、事実の美化なく報告するご姿勢、頼もしいです、警察
lines.en: I appreciate that you're reporting the facts without softening them. That's reassuring.
lines.style: Genuine respect underneath. Slow, considered phrasing. Slight emphasis on 'facts' — acknowledgment of the integrity being described. Warm but formal.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 警察、道義に反する行為を厳しく取り締まります
lines.en: We take strict action against anything that violates our ethical obligations.
lines.style: Firmer than before. Conviction on 'strict action.' No defensiveness, just clarity of principle. The voice settling into what matters most.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 本件、犯罪に加担した者にも責任を問います、警察
lines.en: We hold everyone accountable — including anyone who aided in the crime.
lines.style: Emphasis on 'everyone.' Deliberate, unhurried. The weight of fairness in each phrase. Not threatening — just stating the standard that will be applied.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 警察、横領事件の容疑者を逮捕しました
lines.en: We've arrested the suspect in that embezzlement case.
lines.style: Direct statement of fact. Neutral, professional tone. No triumph or apology — just news delivered clearly. Eyes on the information, not on reaction.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 本件、警察、市民への危害を未然に防がれましたね
lines.en: The police prevented potential harm to citizens before it could happen.
lines.style: Quieter reflection. Recognition of something done right. Slight nod in the voice — acknowledging both the action and its weight.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 警察、儒教文化圏との捜査協力を続けます
lines.en: We're continuing our investigative cooperation with Confucian cultural regions.
lines.style: Closer, almost confiding. Still official but with a hint of personal investment. Steady eye contact through the voice. This matters beyond protocol.
